_comment: BTC VWAP Strangle — the NIFTY/SENSEX Vwap Strangle rules ported to Delta Exchange India BTC daily options. PAPER ONLY (no order path exists). Built 2026-09-15. Two versions run side by side in ONE engine on ONE feed: ist_day (today's expiry, awake hours) and full_expiry (next expiry, 17:35 -> 17:10 next day).

ist_live.label: Vwap New Paper (split legs, own VWAP) — paper reference, never live

ist_cap.label: Vwap 1.5x Paper (split legs + busted leg out at 1.5x VWAP) — paper only

ist_delta.label: Vwap New Delta Ex (split legs) — LIVE-capable

_size_note_20261004: User 2026-10-04: paper versions ist_live + ist_cap at 1000 contracts / -$70 stop; the live ist_delta stays 500 / -$35.
_size_note_20261010: User 2026-10-10 (08:4x IST, before the session): live ist_delta doubled to 1000 contracts / -$70 stop (same stop per contract as before; margin ~$860 of ~$1,160).
_ist_live_note: User rules 2026-10-03: D version (busted leg out, kept leg exits on its own 5-min close above its own VWAP, re-sell only the missing leg), max 4 entries, 500 contracts/leg, stop -$35 on PRICE P&L only (open legs at mark, no fees/spread). ist_live = 'Vwap New Paper': the same rules kept PAPER forever as the reference (2026-10-04). ist_delta = 'Vwap New Delta Ex': identical rules, the only live-capable version — PAPER until armed from the dashboard or tools/vwap_live_control.py (data/vwap_state/live_control_ist_delta.json).
_rules_note: Identical to the NSE Vwap Strangle. Strikes: once at session start, first same-distance-from-ATM CE+PE pair whose combined MARK <= combined_threshold, fixed for the whole cycle. Candles: 5-min combined premium (CE mark + PE mark sampled at the same instant), VWAP = cumulative sum(typical*volume)/sum(volume), typical=(H+L+C)/3, volume = CE+PE traded contracts in that 5 min, resets each cycle. ENTRY: a red candle closing below VWAP arms a sell trigger at low-1; it fills the instant combined premium trades to it; next candle cancels (close above VWAP) or replaces (fresh red-below-VWAP at its new low-1). EXIT: any candle closing above VWAP -> buy back at market. One position at a time, max_entries fills per cycle, no entry after entry_cutoff, flatten at square_off. MTM stop: cycle MTM <= -mtm_stop_usd flattens and stops for the cycle.
_fallback_note: Strikes are ALWAYS equidistant from ATM (ATM+d CE, ATM-d PE, both listed), exactly like NIFTY. If no equidistant pair is <= combined_threshold: full_expiry takes the LAST (farthest) equidistant pair Delta lists (user decision 2026-09-15 — next-day premium at the edge of the listed grid was ~219 at 21:50 IST); ist_day waits and re-checks every poll until one is <= threshold.
_max_entries_note: NSE uses 4 per 6-hour day. ist_day keeps 4 (7.7h). full_expiry runs 23.6h so it gets 8 — change it here if you want strict 4.
_mark_note: BTC options trade thinly, so the last-traded price steps and goes stale for minutes. Candles are built from Delta's MARK (continuous fair value) instead; volume still comes from real trades via the 5m candle history of each leg. Fills never use the mark: every paper entry/exit walks the live L2 book at full size (core/fills.py), and Delta's fee is charged per side.
_size_note: 1000 contracts = 1 BTC per leg, same as the delta-neutral BTC books. Credit at a combined 100 = 100 * 0.001 * 1000 = $100 per strangle.

fees._gst_note: Delta India adds 18% GST to every fee (ledger 2026-10-06: 0.875 + 0.1575 = 1.0325). Used by the split-leg books (ist_live, ist_cap, ist_delta paper fills + exit-fee estimate); the original ist_day/full_expiry books still model the fee WITHOUT GST.

_slippage_guard_note: An entry is only taken if walking the real book fills the pair within this % of the trigger. Otherwise NOTHING is sold and the signal stays armed for a later tick — the paper equivalent of a limit through the touch that does not get hit. Added 2026-09-16 after a 1000-lot sell swept a 119-contract top level and filled at 117 against a 150.2 trigger (23% round-trip). It does not consume one of the day's entries.
_mtm_stop_note: mtm_stop_usd 0 = NO dollar stop (user decision 2026-09-16). Trades exit only on a close above VWAP or at square-off, exactly like the NIFTY rules. The first $50 cycle stop fired 21 seconds after an entry because MTM was valued at the buy-back (ask) side, which books the whole spread the moment you enter.

live_orders._comment: Used only by split_legs versions when armed live. IOC limit orders priced off the live L2 book. Entry: sweep price minus entry_buffer_pct, never below the slippage floor, entry_attempts tries, a half-filled strangle is unwound. Exit: sweep price plus each exit buffer in turn, then a MARKET order; still open -> retried every poll until Delta confirms.
live_orders._leverage_note: Order leverage set on each contract before its first sell (Delta default seen 100x). User 2026-10-04: isolated margin, 200x -> ~$860 for 1000 CE + 1000 PE; 500+500 ~ $430.
